scope: fs-aeroac outputs are relative spectral shapes and scaling laws from a 2D incompressible base flow via Curle's analogy; they are NOT absolute SPL predictions. 2D line-source (cylindrical-spreading) results additionally need a 2D-to-3D span correction before any comparison to measured levels.
